string-array.name: life_theme_descriptions
string-array.item: For when your mind won’t stop racing and tomorrow feels heavy.
Courage from God when you’re afraid.
Trusting God with what hasn’t happened yet.
God’s nearness when you feel alone.
Hope for the dark valleys of the soul.
Strength to keep going when you want to give up.
Rest for the tired and the burned out.
Peace when life is simply too much.
Wisdom for a hot temper and hurt that burns.
Honest questions, and a faithful God.
Accepted by God when others turn away.
Who you are in God’s eyes.
Comfort for a broken heart.
Hope beyond the grave.
Prayer and hope in sickness.
How God meets you in hard things, and what He does through them.
Standing firm when you’re mistreated for your faith.
When wrong seems to win.
Patience when God’s timing isn’t yours.
Healing when someone you trusted hurts you.
Trusting God’s provision under financial strain.
Mercy for what you regret.
God’s complete forgiveness in Christ.
Letting go of what others owe you.
A way out when you’re pulled toward sin.
Freedom from what has a hold on you.
Guarding your heart, your eyes and your body.
Walking humbly before God and others.
Contentment when others seem to have more.
Truthfulness in word and deed.
Repentance, and the welcome home after wandering away.
Mastering appetites, words and impulses by the Spirit.
Love, faithfulness and patience between husband and wife.
Wisdom and grace for raising children.
God’s heart for the little ones, and a word for the young.
A full life with God, married or not.
Being, and finding, a true friend.
Making peace in hard relationships.
Love that is patient, kind, and costly.
Doing your job as service to the Lord.
Seeking God’s direction.
Why you’re here, and what you were made for.
Starting over with God.
God’s faithfulness through every season of life.
God knows what you need.
Enough in God, in plenty or in want.
Giving freely, as God has given.
Following Jesus by serving others.
Believing God, and taking Him at His word.
Leaning on Him when you can’t see the way.
Talking with God, and knowing He hears.
Growing in patience with people, and with God.
Giving thanks in every circumstance.
Joy that doesn’t depend on circumstances.
Following God’s ways from the heart.
Asking God for understanding.
Scripture as light for the path and food for the soul.
Giving God the honor He is due.
Telling others the good news of Jesus.
How wide and long and high and deep His love is.
He is with you, always.
The peace that passes understanding.
An anchor for the soul.
The God of all comfort.
His power in your weakness.
Be strong and courageous.
Your refuge and your fortress.
Knowing you belong to God forever.
God’s kindness you could never earn.
The home God is preparing.
He keeps every promise.
Nothing is outside His hand.
